optimization: C# Native AOT Speed/native ISA and LLVMOnly WASI AOT/SIMD/-O3; Rust release/LTO/native ISA or SIMD; Wasmtime opt-level=2
notes: Peak RSS includes the entire process. For WASI it includes Wasmtime compilation/runtime, not guest allocations alone.

Events are generated and projected in one streaming pass; event construction and dispatch are inside the projection timer. typescript-native is simple unchecked projection; typescript-zod-native validates/clones payload data only in matching handlers, inside the same timer, and ignores unknown event kinds.
Capacity is the largest tested point within the time budget, not a language or hardware maximum.
